items.source: destinationName - the name of the target destination
items.translation: destinationName - 目标目的地的名称

items.source: Receive a message from the given destination.
items.translation: 从给定的目的地接收消息。

items.source:
Receive a message from the given destination and convert its payload to the
specified target class.
items.translation: 从给定的目的地接收消息并将其有效负载转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: messageSelector - the JMS message selector expression (or null if none). See the JMS specification for a detailed definition of selector expressions.
items.translation: messageSelector - JMS 消息选择器表达式（若无则为 null）。有关选择器表达式的详细定义，请参阅 JMS 规范。

items.source: payload - the Object to use as payload
items.translation: payload - 用作负载的 Object。

items.source: the received message, possibly null if the message could not be received, for example due to a timeout
items.translation: 接收到的消息，如果无法接收消息（例如由于超时），则可能为 `null`。

items.source: targetClass - the target class to convert the payload to
items.translation: targetClass - 要将负载转换为目标类

items.source: the converted payload of the reply message, possibly null if the message could not be received, for example due to a timeout
items.translation: 回复消息的转换后的负载，如果无法接收该消息（例如由于超时），则可能为 `null`。

items.source: request - payload for the request message to send
items.translation: request - 要发送的请求消息的有效负载

items.source: targetClass - the target type to convert the payload of the reply to
items.translation: targetClass - 将回复的有效负载转换为目标类型

items.source: the payload of the reply message, possibly null if the message could not be received, for example due to a timeout
items.translation: 回复消息的有效负载，如果无法接收消息（例如由于超时），则可能为 `null`。

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, send it as a Message to the given destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the specified target class.
items.translation: 将给定的请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其作为Message发送到给定的目的地，接收回复并将其主体转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, apply the given post-processor and send the resulting Message to the given destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the given target class.
items.translation: 将给定的请求对象转换为序列化形式，可能使用MessageConverter，应用给定的后置处理器，并将生成的Message发送到给定目的地，接收回复并将其主体转换为给定目标类。

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, send it as a Message with the given headers, to the specified destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the specified target class.
items.translation: 将给定的请求对象转换为序列化形式（可能使用MessageConverter），将其作为带有给定标头的Message发送到指定的目的地，接收回复并将其正文转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Convert the given request Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers, apply the given post-processor and send the resulting Message to the specified destination, receive the reply and convert its body of the given target class.
items.translation: 将给定的请求对象转换为序列化形式，可能使用MessageConverter，将其包装为带有给定标头的消息，应用给定的后置处理器，并将生成的Message发送到指定的目的地，接收回复并将其主体转换为给定的目标类。

items.source: Convert the given Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message and send it to the given destination.
items.translation: 将给定的对象转换为序列化形式，可能使用 `MessageConverter` 包装它作为消息并发送到给定目的地。

items.source: Convert the given Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers and send it to the given destination.
items.translation: 将给定的 Object 转换为序列化形式，可能使用MessageConverter，将其包装为带有给定标头的消息并发送到给定目的地。

items.source: Convert the given Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message, apply the given post-processor, and send the resulting message to the given destination.
items.translation: 将给定的对象转换为序列化形式，可能使用MessageConverter，将其包装为消息，应用给定的后置处理器，并将生成的消息发送到给定的目的地。

items.source: Note: Operations in this interface throw MessagingException instead of the JMS-specific JmsException, aligning with the spring-messaging module and its other client operation handles.
items.translation: 注意：此接口中的操作抛出 `MessagingException` 而非 JMS 特定的 `JmsException`，这与 `spring-messaging` 模块及其其他客户端操作处理器保持一致。

items.source: Convert the given Object to serialized form, possibly using a MessageConverter, wrap it as a message with the given headers, apply the given post-processor, and send the resulting message to the given destination.
items.translation: 将给定的对象转换为序列化形式，可能使用MessageConverter，将其包装为带有给定标头的消息，应用给定的后置处理器，并将生成的消息发送到给定的目的地。

items.source: Receive a message from the default destination.
items.translation: 从默认目的地接收消息。

items.source:
Receive a message from the default destination and convert its payload to the
specified target class.
items.translation: 从默认目的地接收消息并将其有效负载转换为指定的目标类。

items.source: Send a message to the given destination.
items.translation: 向给定的目的地发送消息。

items.source: Send a request message and receive the reply from the given destination.
items.translation: 发送请求消息并从指定的目的地接收回复。

items.source: headers - the headers for the message to send
items.translation: headers - 要发送的消息的标头

items.source: postProcessor - the post-processor to apply to the message
items.translation: postProcessor - 要应用于消息的后处理器

items.source: destination - the target destination
items.translation: destination - 目标目的地

items.source: requestPostProcessor - post-process to apply to the request message
items.translation: requestPostProcessor - 用于对请求消息进行后处理的处理器

items.source: message - the message to send
items.translation: message - 要发送的消息

items.source: requestMessage - the message to send
items.translation: requestMessage - 要发送的消息

items.source: the reply, possibly null if the message could not be received, for example due to a timeout
items.translation: 回复，如果消息无法接收（例如由于超时），则可能为 `null`。

items.source: headers - the headers for the request message to send
items.translation: headers - 要发送的请求消息的标头

items.translation: Stephane Nicoll，Juergen Hoeller
